user_summary: 修复 Apple Silicon 上 StoryLens 主程序可以打开、但本地分析服务随即退出的问题，并在查看详情中显示真实退出原因。
technical_summary: 真实 Apple Silicon 设备证明 onefile 候选仍会在 _MEI 临时目录加载到不同 Team ID 的 Python.framework。macOS Sidecar 因此改为 PyInstaller onedir：完整 Python 运行目录随 App 交付、逐个验证所有 Mach-O 签名，并整体复制到无 quarantine 的版本化运行目录；Windows onefile 保持不变。
acceptance_criteria: ARM64 DMG 内桌面程序能在 bundled sidecar 带 quarantine 时拉起运行副本
桌面拉起的 sidecar /health 返回成功
查看详情能显示 sidecar 退出状态与错误摘要
ARM64 sidecar 主程序、Python Framework 与全部 Mach-O 使用相同签名身份
签名不一致时构建必须失败，不能再上传表面通过的 DMG
macOS 运行日志不得再出现 PyInstaller _MEI 临时 Python.framework 加载路径
DMG 内及复制后的 onedir Sidecar 必须从桌面程序启动并通过 /health
tests: Rust desktop runtime 定向测试
前端 DesktopBootstrap 定向测试
macOS sidecar 签名解析与 Team ID 配对单元测试
GitHub macOS ARM64 quarantine 桌面端到 sidecar 启动冒烟
历史 DMG 内 onefile 嵌入 Python 签名一致性门禁
macOS onedir 文件树与所有 Mach-O 签名一致性门禁
macOS 完整 Sidecar 目录无扩展属性复制与真实桌面启动冒烟
verification_evidence: GitHub Actions run 33258766423: ARM64 and x64 passed
ARM64 smoke injected quarantine into bundled sidecar, launched the desktop, and reached /health
User machine rejected embedded Python.framework with different Team IDs; previous CI smoke was insufficient
GitHub Actions run 33300136440 correctly blocked the first candidate because the archive checker treated two Framework symlinks as separate Python binaries
GitHub Actions run 33300709850 confirmed standalone outer_team=adhoc and embedded_python_team=adhoc; build then exposed Tauri cleanup of the intermediate app and was correctly blocked before upload
GitHub Actions run 33301215002 passed ARM64 and x64 build, packaged-DMG signature checks, desktop runtime tests, and release smoke tests
ARM64 packaged sidecar passed outer_team=adhoc and embedded_python_team=adhoc checks before and after mounting the DMG
ARM64 installed-app startup smoke reached /health and reported MACOS RELEASE SMOKE OK (arm64)
User confirmed StoryLens_1.3.6_arm64-signfix-candidate.dmg still exits 255 on a real Apple Silicon machine with different Team IDs while loading _MEI/Python.framework; candidate is superseded
Replacement uses a visible PyInstaller onedir runtime and remains pending macOS build plus real-device verification

First onedir CI attempt failed closed before upload because the copied Python.org Framework binary retained a bundle signature whose covered resources were absent; the build now re-signs every collected Mach-O as an independent code object before strict verification

Second onedir CI attempt passed the Mach-O signature gate, then failed closed because placing the runtime under Contents/MacOS made codesign treat Python dist-info metadata as a code subcomponent; the runtime is now bundled under Contents/Resources and copied out before execution

Third onedir CI attempt built and signed the DMG, verified 203 Mach-O files, launched the desktop-spawned sidecar and reached /health; only the final smoke assertion looked under API STORYLENS_DATA_DIR instead of Tauri Application Support, so the assertion now locates the isolated app_local_data_dir under the smoke HOME

data_compatibility.notes: 仅改变 macOS Sidecar 打包与启动复制方式；不修改数据库和用户数据。
